description: Permanently deletes one saved word with its meanings, examples, group memberships and practice progress. Requires the word's latest version from find_my_words or save_word; a stale version returns WORD_CHANGED without deleting. requestId makes retries idempotent.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque revision token from the latest read or save of this item. A stale token returns WORD_CHANGED or GROUP_CHANGED without saving.

itemId.description: ID of the saved word to delete.

languageCode.description: Code of the learning language, for example en-GB or es-ES.

name: delete_word
title: Remove a saved word
